title: WIP: LLM Odyssey: A Game-Based Platform for Teaching LLM Engineering Concepts
abstract: arXiv:2608.16924v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This work-in-progress (WIP) innovative practice category paper presents LLM Odyssey, an open source, browser-based serious gaming platform comprising 13 interactive games for teaching Large Language Model (LLM) engineering concepts. Topics such as tokenization, transformer architecture, prompt engineering, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), and production deployment are underrepresented in computer science curricula. Existing interactive tools address individual concepts but lack pedagogical scaffolding or structured learning pathways. LLM Odyssey addresses this gap through three learning tiers aligned with Bloom's revised taxonomy: Cognitive Core (7 foundational games), Systems Forge (5 production engineering games), and Foundry Arena (capstone challenges). translated_title: 工作进展：LLM奥德赛——一个基于游戏的教学平台，用于教授LLM工程概念
translated_abstract: 这篇工作进展（WIP）创新实践类论文介绍了LLM奥德赛，一个开源、基于浏览器的严肃游戏平台，包含13个互动游戏，用于教授大型语言模型（LLM）工程概念。诸如分词、Transformer架构、提示工程、检索增强生成（RAG）和生产部署等主题在计算机科学课程中代表性不足。现有互动工具针对单个概念，但缺乏教学支架或结构化学习路径。LLM奥德赛通过三个与布卢姆修订分类法对齐的学习层级填补了这一空白：认知核心（7个基础游戏）、系统锻造（5个生产工程游戏）和铸造竞技场（顶点挑战）。每个游戏融入了文献中的五种教学策略：即时形成性反馈、基于最近发展区的支架式提示、进度追踪（原文截断）
tldr: 本文提出了LLM奥德赛，一个包含13个游戏的开源教学平台，通过三个学习层级和五种教学策略，系统性地教授LLM工程概念，填补了现有工具缺乏教学支架和结构化学习路径的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LLM Odyssey, an open-source platform with 13 games that systematically teaches LLM engineering concepts through three learning tiers and five pedagogical strategies, addressing the gap of missing scaffolding and structured pathways in existing tools.
